bias.en: Downtrend · rejected at the 5 and 10-day, holding $144–145
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 受阻于 5 日和 10 日均线，守住 $144–145

read.en: Marvell fell 2.2% on Nov 18 to $145.54, trading $142.62–152.23 on light volume (0.62x the 20-day average). It is below the 10-day ($151.3, falling), 5-day ($152.2), 200-day ($188.0), 30-day ($204.5) and 100-day ($221.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($163.81), and RSI is 33.4.
read.zh: Marvell 11月18日下跌 2.2%，收于 $145.54，盘中区间 $142.62–152.23，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.62 倍）。股价位于 10 日（$151.3，下行）、5 日（$152.2）、200 日（$188.0）、30 日（$204.5）和 100 日均线（$221.7）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$163.81），RSI 为 33.4。

read.en: The $152.23 high was turned back at the 5 and 10-day averages and the stock fell back below $149; the $142.62 low undercut the Nov 16 low ($144.04) intraday, but the close held the Nov 16 close ($145.36). Resistance is $148.7–151, then $151.3–152.2 and $154.4–154.6. Support is $142.6–144, then $140.9–141.2 and $135.3. A close above $151 would target $152–155; below $142.6, $141, then $135.
